FestivalSpectator_Dialog_0: Every year this race gets more exciting. I love seeing how the horses have grown!
FestivalSpectator_Dialog_1: The Horse Festival is one of my favorite days of the year. Spring just wouldn't feel right without it.
FestivalSpectator_Dialog_2: I always look forward to this. There's nothing like watching the race on a day like today.
FestivalSpectator_Dialog_3: It's a great turnout this year! The horses look fantastic.
FestivalSpectator_Dialog_4: I've been coming to this race for years. It never gets old.
FestivalSpectator_Dialog_5: I always make sure to clear my schedule for this. Wouldn't want to miss the race!
FestivalSpectator_Dialog_6: The whole valley comes out for this one. It's one of the best days of the year.
FestivalSpectator_Dialog_7: Nothing beats a sunny spring day and a good horse race. I'm glad I made it out here.
